item.title: October 15, 2026 Tax Extension Deadline: What to Do Before It Hits
item.description: Filed an extension for your 2025 return? Your deadline is Thursday, Oct. 15, 2026. Here's what to file, what it costs to wait, and the NJ and disaster-area exceptions.
